scope: Original authored tone gain and calibration routing metadata

tone_volume.negative_value: literal authored value rounded to float32
tone_volume.output_gain: Native0x690003 SetParam15 and Execute; use original instance, not per-amp median normalization
tone_volume.initialization: Apply curve-converted SetParam15 before original Init to avoid an unintended first-block gain ramp
tone_volume.update: Use original SetParam15 and Execute; original gain routine ramps changes across a block

input_calibration.selection_required: Resolve the actual input-mode bus route before selecting a calibration profile

limitations: Bus OverrideBusId layout is corroborated by local wwiser parser first field; full version91 bus parsing is not claimed.
Effect/RTPC matches inside bus bodies retain exact offsets; variable record offsets are not guessed.
Input calibration has multiple mode-dependent consumers; select using actual original bus route, not an arbitrary branch.
Full captured game audio and real input calibration measurements remain unverified.
Tone-balance gain placement is traced; original downstream bus-amplitude execution is not replayed.
Fixed bus FX arrays are structurally checked at exact source offsets; runtime bus bypass, state and property changes still require replay.
Native input calibration measurement and mode selection are separate from authored tone Volume.
